headline: Is paying artists enough to convince them to embrace AI?
summary: Artists protest AI models trained on their work without permission. Legal battles are ongoing due to perceived theft. Some propose artist royalties as a potential solution.

headline: Foldables are sort of boring now — and that’s great news for Apple
summary: Foldable phones are becoming less exciting as the tech matures. This maturity makes them less of a novel threat to Apple. The current state benefits Apple's traditional smartphone market.

headline: Pixel 11 specs and price leak with no surprises
summary: Leaked details for the Pixel 11 series confirm prior rumors. The Pixel 11 is expected to see a $100 price increase. It will reportedly start at $899 with 256GB storage.

headline: Angela Nissel faces down grief with a laugh
summary: Angela Nissel's new memoir, 'Good Grief, Pass the Bread, Mom Is Dead,' is highlighted. The book explores caring for a terminally ill parent. It uses gallows humor to navigate a deeply emotional tale.

headline: Spider-Man: Brand New Day Beats Avengers: Endgame Record to Claim Biggest Domestic Opening Day of All Time
summary: 'Spider-Man: Brand New Day' shattered box office records. It achieved the biggest domestic opening day ever. The film earned a massive $168 million on its first day.

headline: Game of Thrones: The Mad King Reveals Full Stage Cast and First Portrait
summary: The stage play 'Game of Thrones: The Mad King' announced its full cast. A first official cast photo was released. Key characters like Aerys II and Rhaegar Targaryen are featured.

headline: Vincent Pastore, The Sopranos Actor, Dies at 80
summary: Actor Vincent Pastore, known from 'The Sopranos,' has passed away. He was 80 years old. Pastore famously played Salvatore Bonpensiero in the TV series.

headline: Elden Ring Players Are Hoping for Godwyn DLC After FromSoftware Shares Cryptic Social Media Post
summary: FromSoftware shared a cryptic social media post. 'Elden Ring' fans speculate about new Godwyn DLC. This comes two years after the 'Shadow of the Erdtree' expansion.

headline: Trump cancels Iran strikes subject to deal being made 'rapidly'
summary: Trump claims Iran requested a halt to US strikes. He states 'perimeters' of a deal have been agreed upon. Strikes are canceled if a deal is made rapidly.

headline: Continued drought could cause shortage of certain foods, head of farmers' union says
summary: UK farmers' union president warns of potential food shortages. Ongoing drought is cited as the primary cause. Government action is urged to mitigate extreme weather impacts.

headline: The shadowy gang recruiting teenage hitmen to kill across Europe
summary: The Foxtrot Network is a shadowy gang operating in Europe. They are linked to approximately 35 murders. The group uses 'violence-as-a-service' tactics, recruiting teens.

headline: Five dead, 41 missing, after Indonesia ferry catches fire
summary: A ferry carrying 250 people caught fire off Madura island, Indonesia. Five fatalities have been confirmed. Search operations are ongoing for 41 missing passengers.
